experiment: bounded observed-failure replay vs existing controller; not Z.ai agent reproduction

suiteLock.protocol: All manifests locked before any run; all seeds scored, no seed filtering or policy tuning on final labels. This suite is development stress evidence, not a pristine deployment qualification set.

environment.sourceState: Evaluated source files are untracked; use sourceHashes and binary hashes, not HEAD alone.
environment.execution: sequential local release executable; temporary SQLite; no model loaded
environment.measurement: sysctl model/CPU/memory, sw_vers and local compiler queried on benchmark host; serial numbers not collected
environment.resourceLimits: Shared host; power mode, peak RAM and sustained thermal behavior not measured.

decisions.reason: Insufficient independent evidence, no strict gain, or a regression/failure; retain incumbent.

limitations: Fresh seeds from an existing authored generator, not new real-user data or independent scenario design.
Historical feedback can be noisy or stale; bank uses frozen pre-event snapshots and is not a full future-trajectory counterfactual.
Public control reuses cached ASR hypotheses with simulated corrections; no fresh acoustic inference.
Word-edit totals are not normalized WER or independently judged meaning preservation.
Replay/component timings exclude actual ASR, UI and insertion; no battery or thermal qualification.
